name: GM CCA - Boston Parts Distribution Center, Mansfield MA

fieldNotes._facility: The GM CCA Boston PDC was the ~404,000 sq ft GM Service & Parts Operations distribution center built ~2004-2005 in the Norton Commerce Center, Norton MA (just north of Mansfield), serving 400+ New England/NY dealers. GM closed it end of 2009 in bankruptcy; Condyne rehabbed/expanded it and Horizon Beverage bought it in 2012 and now occupies it as their HQ/DC (solar-covered roof added). The audited building is the original GM PDC structure at ~15/45 Commerce Way, Norton MA 02766 (41.9592,-71.1392). No GM-operated parts DC currently exists at/near Mansfield-Boston.
fieldNotes.truckGate: No barrier arm, sliding gate, or guard checkpoint at the property edge. Street View along Commerce Way (Aug 2025) shows open lawn frontage with no perimeter fence; the dock yard and drop area sit set back behind the building. Open suburban industrial-park access. truckGate=false.
fieldNotes.guardShack: No staffed booth at any entrance. A small round white structure and a rectangular shed sit in the dock apron (utility silo / electrical, not a gatehouse). guardShack=false.
fieldNotes.remoteGs: No gate present, so remoteGs=false (no kiosk/call-box check-in either).
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Loading docks line the long southwest face of the building; trailers backed in at the NW and south ends with a continuous dock wall ~600 ft long. Estimated ~42 doors across the SW face -> 25-50 band (could reach 50+); flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Curving access drive at the SW/south end holds rows of parked trailers without tractors plus a striped trailer-parking lane; ~20-30 trailers visible -> 10-25 band drop area.
fieldNotes.dropYard: Dedicated trailer-storage along the southern loop drive, separate from the active dock apron. dropYard=true.
fieldNotes.postGateStaging: Large paved apron between the SW dock wall and the access loop gives ample interior holding room before docks; postGateStaging=true.
fieldNotes.drivewayLong: Deep paved apron / loop drive can stack 3+ trucks approaching the dock face; drivewayLong=true.
fieldNotes.railServed: No rail spur into the property; nearest rail is the MBTA/Amtrak Northeast Corridor well to the west, not connected. railServed=false.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Edge-of-town suburban industrial park in Norton MA off Route 140 / near I-495, surrounded by woods and wetland; judged Rural per rubric (small-town industrial).
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: No truck gate exists, so no express-lane opportunity at a checkpoint; set false.
fieldNotes.entryLanes: Single shared two-way driveway loop serves the dock yard; entry/exit lane counts inferred as 1/1, flagged uncertain.
